description: NaSbN₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five N atoms to form distorted NaN₅ square pyramids that share corners with eight SbN₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaN₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SbN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.82 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to four N atoms to form SbN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaN₅ square pyramids and corners with four SbN₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Sb-N bond lengths. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to four N atoms to form SbN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaN₅ square pyramids, corners with four SbN₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaN₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Sb-N bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.02 Å. There are four inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NNa₂Sb₂ tetrahedra. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Sb atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Sb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NNa₂Sb₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth N site, N is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Sb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NNa₂Sb₂ trigonal pyramids.
